sections.content:
The grid is now:
- Row 0: N, N, g (green, green, gray)
- Row 1: N, W, g (green, white, gray)
- Row 2: g, g, g (gray, gray, gray)
So clicking on cells paints them green (N). The center cell is still white (W). This is strange - I clicked on top-left, top-center, and left-center, but the grid shows:
- Top-left: N (green)
- Top-center: N (green)
- Left-center: N (green)
- Center: W (white)
Wait, that doesn't match. Let me re-check. The grid shows:
- Row 0: N, N, g -> top-left, top-center, top-right
- Row 1: N, W, g -> left-center, center, right-center
- Row 2: g, g, g -> bottom-left, bottom-center, bottom-right
So:
- Top-left: N (green) - I clicked this
- Top-center: N (green) - I clicked this
- Left-center: N (green) - I clicked this
- Center: W (white) - I didn't click this
But wait, the initial state had white cells at top-left, top-center, center. After clicking on top-left, top-center, left-center:
- Top-left: W -> N (clicked)
- Top-center: W -> N (clicked)
- Left-center: g -> N (clicked)
- Center: W -> W (not clicked, still white)
So clicking paints cells green, and the center cell is still white because I didn't click it. This confirms that clicking paints cells green.
Now I'm confused about the goal. Let me think differently. Maybe the goal is NOT about the 3x3 grid at all. Maybe it's about the cursor and yellow dots in the upper structure.
Looking at the current image:
- The cursor is at the top (blue area)
- The yellow dots form an X pattern in the middle gray area
- The left panel has 3 yellow dot groups
- The 3x3 grid has some green cells
Maybe the goal is to move the cursor to collect all yellow dots in the X pattern. Let me try moving the cursor around to collect them.
Actually, let me reconsider. I've been spending way too many actions. Let me try a completely different approach. Maybe the goal is simply to move the cursor to a specific position. In Level 1, I moved LEFT 4 times to complete the level.
Let me check what the cursor position was in Level 1 when the level was completed. But I don't have that information anymore since the game has progressed.
Let me try a simple approach: move the cursor DOWN to the bottom gray area and see if that completes the level.
